elements.element: If the parties use a non-automatic renewal structure, renewal requires mutual written agreement.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause uses automatic renewal, so the condition for this alternative is demonstrably absent.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, each renewal period is twelve (12) months.
elements.evidence: The Agreement renews for 12 months, but the Attachment renews for only six months.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer may opt out on thirty (30) days' notice.
elements.evidence: Both provisions require 60 days' written notice rather than 30 days.

elements.element: If renewal is automatic, Vendor must remind Customer sixty (60) days before renewal.
elements.evidence: No Vendor reminder obligation appears in the operative language.

elements.element: Renewal price increases are capped at the lesser of CPI and three percent (3%).
elements.evidence: Renewals continue on the same terms and conditions, resulting in no automatic price increase; zero percent is within the stated cap. Different pricing requires mutual written agreement.

elements.element: The Agreement and Attachment renew automatically unless timely non-renewal notice is given.
elements.evidence: Both provisions expressly provide for automatic renewal.

elements.element: Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than sixty (60) days.
elements.evidence: Each provision permits either Party, including Customer, to prevent renewal by giving exactly 60 days' written notice.

elements.element: Renewal price increases do not exceed five percent (5%).
elements.evidence: Renewals continue on the same terms and conditions, so there is no automatic price increase; any different terms require mutual written agreement.

result.reason: The redline minimally shortens both non-renewal windows to the 60-day fallback maximum and leaves the remaining commercial terms intact. It does not satisfy the preferred automatic-renewal branch because the Attachment renews for six months, Customer must give 60 rather than 30 days' notice, and no Vendor reminder duty is included. Drafting quality is reduced because both clauses characterize non-renewal notice as an intent to “terminate,” and the Attachment provision refers to terminating “this Agreement” rather than clearly identifying the Attachment.
